sanskrit: atyāsarat prathamā dhokṣyamāṇā sarvān yajñān bibhratī vaiśvadevī | upa vatsaṃ sṛjata vāśyate gaur vy asṛṣṭa sumanā hiṃ kṛṇoti ||
english: She who is to be milked, bearing all sacrifices — the all-divine one — ran forth first. Let the calf be loosed; the cow lows. When released, contented, she makes the sound hiṃ.

sanskrit: badhāna vatsam abhi dhehi bhuñjatīṃ ni dya godhug upa sīda dugdhi | iḍām asmā odanaṃ pinvamānā kīlālaṃ ghṛtaṃ madam annabhāgam ||
english: Tether the calf, set her to the one that would suckle it, today let the milk-pail sit down and be milked. Swelling with iḍā — the rice-oblation — let her yield sweet drink, ghee, exhilaration, and a share of food for him.

sanskrit: sā dhāvatu yamarājñaḥ savatsā sukṛtāṃ pathā prathameha dattā | atṛṣṭa dattā prathamedam āgan vatsena gāṃ saṃ sṛja viśvarūpām ||
english: Let her run with her calf to the realm of Yama-king, along the path of the blessed — she who was given here as the first gift. Given without compulsion, she who was given first has come hither. Unite the cow of all forms with her calf.

sanskrit: prathamedam āgan prathamā dattetād yasmim̐l loke sadya u tvā dadāti | sainaṃ dheno prathamā pārayāsi śraddhayā dattā parame vyoman ||
english: She came here first, she who was given as the very first — she by whom, in that world, he immediately gives you. O milk-cow, as the first you shall carry him across. Given with faith, she dwells in the highest heaven.

sanskrit: jānīhi sma saṃskṛte dheno gopatiṃ yas tvā dadāti prathamāṃ svadhānām | pūrvā hi tatra sukṛtaḥ parehy athaiṣa aitā jarasaḥ parastāt ||
english: Know, O milk-cow prepared with rites, the lord of cattle who gives you as the foremost of gifts of svadhā. For there the meritorious deeds of former times pass on; and this one shall come to the far side beyond old age.

sanskrit: ati dhenur anaḍvāham aty anyad vayo akramīt | ati vatsānāṃ pitaraṃ ṛṣabhaṃ pratimāsarat ||
english: The milk-cow strode beyond the draught ox, beyond any other creature; she ran back facing the bull, the father of calves.

sanskrit: jyotiṣmatī sukṛto yāhi sūre syonās te dheno patayo bhavantu | sapta tvā sūryā anvātapantu yamaṃ dhāva māti saraḥ parācīḥ ||
english: Luminous one, go to the blessed among the brilliant! O milk-cow, let your lords be gracious. May the seven suns shine upon you. Run to Yama; do not stray away from the path, wandering into the distance.

sanskrit: dātre *'mutra mahyaṃ duhānā- -ubhau lokau bhuñjatī vi kramasva | iṣam ūrjaṃ dakṣiṇāḥ saṃvasānā bhagasya dhārām avase pratīmaḥ ||
english: Yielding milk yonder for the giver, for me, enjoying both worlds, stride forth. Clothed together in the ritual fees, in nourishment and vital energy, we encounter the stream of Bhaga for our protection.

sanskrit: sahasrāṅgā śataṃ jyotīṃṣy asyā yajñasya paprir amṛtā svargā | sā na aitu dakṣiṇā viśvarūpā- -ahiṃsantīṃ prati gṛhṇīma enām ||
english: She of a thousand limbs, a hundred luminaries belong to her — the purifier of the sacrifice, the immortal, the heavenly one. Let that ritual fee of all forms come to us; we receive her who does no harm.

sanskrit: ye te pāśā varuṇa sapta saptatīs tredhā tiṣṭhanti viṣitā ruśantaḥ | sinanti sarve anṛtaṃ vadantaṃ yaḥ satyavādy ati taṃ sṛjanti ||
english: Your snares, O Varuṇa — seven, seventy — stand deployed in three places, gleaming. They bind every speaker of falsehood; the one who speaks truth they let pass beyond.

sanskrit: iha spaśaḥ pra carantīme asya sahasrākṣā ati paśyanti bhūmim | yo 'sya vrataṃ pramināti kaś ca na sa mucyate varuṇasya pāśāt ||
english: Here his spies range about; these thousand-eyed ones survey the earth. Whoever violates his ordinance in any way — he is not freed from the snare of Varuṇa.

sanskrit: uteyam asya pṛthivī samīcy utāsau dyaur bṛhatī dūreantā | uto samudro varuṇasya kukṣā utāsminn alpa udake namuktaḥ ||
english: This broad earth is in accord with him; so too is yonder great sky of distant ends. And the ocean is Varuṇa's belly; and in this little water he is also not unloosed.

sanskrit: yas tiṣṭhati manasā yaś ca vañcati yo nilāyaṃ carati yaḥ pralāyam | dvau yadyad vadataḥ sanniṣadya rājā tad veda varuṇas tṛtīyaḥ ||
english: He who stands still with the mind, he who deceives, he who moves in concealment, he who moves in dispersal — whatever two people say sitting together, King Varuṇa knows it as the third.

sanskrit: sarvaṃ tad rajā varuṇo vi caṣṭe yad antarā rodasī yat parastāt | saṃkhyātā asya nimiṣo janānām akṣān na śvaghnī bhuvanā mimīte ||
english: All that King Varuṇa surveys — what lies between the two world-halves, what lies beyond. The twinkling of men's eyes is counted by him; like a gambler counting dice, he measures the worlds.

sanskrit: tvam eva rājan varuṇa dhartā devānām asi viśvarūpaḥ | duścarmāstv adhamaḥ piśaṅgo yaḥ satyāṃ vācam anṛtena hanti ||
english: You alone, O King Varuṇa, are the upholder of the gods; you are all-formed. Let him be wretched of skin — the lowest, the tawny one — who strikes down truthful speech with falsehood.

sanskrit: yaḥ samāmyo varuṇo yo vyāmyo yaḥ sandeśyo varuṇo yo videśyaḥ | yo daivyo varuṇo yaś ca mānuṣaḥ sarvāṃs tve tān prati muñcāmy atra ||
english: The Varuṇa who belongs to one's own village, the Varuṇa who belongs to the foreign village; the Varuṇa of the home district, the Varuṇa of the alien district; the divine Varuṇa and the human Varuṇa — I release all of them from you here.

sanskrit: śatena pāśair varuṇābhi dhehi mā te mocy anṛtavāṅ nṛcakṣaḥ | āstāṃ jālma udaraṃ śraṃsayitvā kośa ivābandhraḥ parikṛtyamānaḥ ||
english: Bind him about, O Varuṇa, with a hundred snares; let the speaker of falsehood not be freed from you, O all-seeing one. Let the wretch sit with his belly sagging, being trimmed around like a sheath without its string.

sanskrit: uto tvat pra pātayaty uto tvad api nahyati | uto tvad asvakaṃ kṛtvā rājā varuṇa īyate ||
english: He makes him fall down from you; he also ties him down to you. He also makes him propertyless — thus King Varuṇa moves about.

sanskrit: ainaṃ chinatti varuṇo naḍaṃ kaśipune yathā | mūlaṃ tasya vṛścati ya enaṃ pramimīṣati ||
english: Varuṇa cuts him down as a reed is cut for a mat. He cuts out the root of the one who wishes to do him harm.

sanskrit: ya imāṃ devo mekhalām ābabandha yaḥ saṃnanāha ya u mā yuyoja | yasya devasya praśiṣā carāmi sa pāram icchāt sa u mā vi muñcāt ||
english: The god who bound this girdle upon me, who fastened it on, who also yoked me — at whose divine instruction I move — may he seek the far shore; may he also release me.

sanskrit: āhutāsy abhihuta ṛṣīṇām asy āyudham | pūrvā vratasya prāśnatī vīraghnī bhava mekhale ||
english: You are offered, you are well-offered; you are the weapon of the seers. Partaking first of the vow, O girdle, become a slayer of heroes.

sanskrit: mṛtyor ahaṃ brahmacārī yad asmi bhūtān niryācan puruṣaṃ yamāya | tam ahaṃ brahmaṇā tapasā śrameṇa- -anayainaṃ mekhalayā sināmi ||
english: Inasmuch as I am a student of sacred knowledge pursuing death — wresting beings, man and all, away for Yama — with Brahman, with austerity, with effort, with this girdle I bind him.

sanskrit: ayaṃ vajras tarpayatāṃ vratena- -avāsya rāṣṭram abhi hantu jīvam | bhinattu skandhān pra śṛṇātūṣṇihāḥ ||
english: Let this thunderbolt satisfy through vow; let it strike down alive the kingdom of this one. Let it cleave his shoulders; let the meters shatter them.

sanskrit: adharottaram adharottareṇa gūḍhaḥ pṛthivyā mot sṛpat | vajreṇāvahataḥ śayām ||
english: Below and above, lower and lower still, hidden by the earth, let him not creep out. Struck down by the thunderbolt, may he lie.

sanskrit: yo jināti tam anv iccha yo jināti tam ij jahi | jinato vajra sāyaka sīmantam anvañcam anu pātaya ||
english: Him who conquers — seek him out; him who conquers — strike him down. O thunderbolt, O missile, strike down the one who conquers, striking him along the parting of his hair.

sanskrit: yad aśnāmi balaṃ kurve vajram ā dadā iti | skandhān amuṣya śātayan vṛtrasyeva śacīpatiḥ ||
english: When I eat, I make strength; I take up the thunderbolt, as it were. Shattering the shoulders of that one, like the lord of Śacī against Vṛtra.

sanskrit: yat pibāmi saṃ pibāmi samudra iva saṃpibaḥ | prāṇān amuṣya saṃpiban saṃ pibāmy ahaṃ pibam ||
english: When I drink, I drink him up together; like an ocean, a drinker-together. Drinking up together the vital breaths of that one, I drink him up together — let me drink.

sanskrit: yad girāmi saṃ girāmi samudra iva saṃgiraḥ | prāṇān amuṣya saṃgiran saṃ girāmy ahaṃ giram ||
english: When I swallow, I swallow him up together; like an ocean, a swallower-together. Swallowing together the vital breaths of that one, I swallow him up together — let me swallow.

sanskrit: śraddhāyā duhitā tapaso 'dhi jātā svasa rṣīṇāṃ bhūtakṛtāṃ babhūva | sā no mekhale matim ā dhehi medhām atho no dhehi tapa indriyaṃ ca ||
english: Born of Faith, sprung from austerity — the sister of the seers and of the creators of beings she became. O girdle, place in us understanding, wisdom; and grant us austerity and vital power.

sanskrit: yāṃ tvā pūrve bhūtakṛta ṛṣayaḥ paribedhire | sā tvaṃ pari ṣvajasva mā dīrghāyutvāya mekhale ||
english: You whom the seers of former times, the creators of beings, encircled — do you encircle me, O girdle, for long life.
